caseStudy.blurb: Agility's ProMat 2025 booth, the industry debut of Digit Gen 4's beta, designed as one brand system across every touchpoint on the show floor.
caseStudy.team: Graphic Designer (me), Director of Design, CMO, Event Coordinator, Booth Manufacturer
objectives: Debut Digit Gen 4 as credible, working technology.
Hold the brand together across wall graphics, LED screens, print, and apparel.
Draw customer interest from across a crowded show floor.
caseStudy.contribution: As Agility's sole graphic designer, I owned the booth's full visual footprint over three months: large-format wall graphics, LED panel content, printed handouts, and team apparel. I led with large-scale renders of Digit, kept interior walls quiet for live demos, and worked directly with the booth manufacturer and event coordinator through production.
results: High foot traffic despite edge-of-floor placement.
Large-format prints with accurate color and resolution, on par with surrounding booths.
Team apparel the crew still wears around the office.
